# DIY Poké Card

> DIY Poké Card (diypokecard.com) is a free, browser-based maker for fan-made trading cards. Start from an original character, your own photo or drawing, or a one-line idea that AI turns into original artwork, then edit, download and print the card. Independent; not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc. or The Pokémon Company.

## Key facts

- Free: the card editor, original companion characters, your own photos and drawings, 2D/3D preview with holo and cosmic finishes, PNG downloads (945 × 1,320 px), interactive HTML downloads, a local collection of up to 60 cards, and home printing.
- No sign-up is needed. An adult email is only used for purchases and restoring credits.
- AI artwork is optional. New visitors get one free AI picture when AI is available. One-time packs: 15 for $4.99, 40 for $9.99, 90 for $19.99 USD. No subscription. Technical failures return the credit.
- AI images use the FLUX.2 klein 9B model and card text uses Llama 3.3 70B, both on Cloudflare Workers AI. Ideas must be original and family-friendly; named franchise characters are declined without using a credit.
- Photos added in "My photo" stay in the browser. A photo is sent for AI processing only when an adult chooses AI art and confirms permission.
- Printing: 63 × 88 mm cards, nine per A4 or US Letter sheet, cut guides and a 50 mm calibration line. Digital shine is not physical foil.
- English interface. Cards are for personal play, gifts and home games, not official tournaments.

## Make a card

- [Card maker](https://diypokecard.com/): Type an idea, use a photo, or start from 12 real examples.
- [AI trading card generator](https://diypokecard.com/ai-trading-card-generator): How text-to-card AI works, writing tips, prices.
- [Pet trading cards](https://diypokecard.com/pet-trading-card): Free photo cards or illustrated AI portraits of a dog, cat or other pet.
- [Birthday trading cards](https://diypokecard.com/birthday-trading-card): Birthday hero cards, party favors and matching sets.
- [Drawing to trading card](https://diypokecard.com/drawing-to-trading-card): Keep a child's drawing as is, or let AI illustrate it.
- [Photo cards](https://diypokecard.com/photo-card-maker): Local photo editing and crop controls.
- [Holographic cards](https://diypokecard.com/holographic-card-maker): 2D versus 3D, finishes, interactive downloads.
- [Printing](https://diypokecard.com/printable-trading-cards): A4 or Letter layout at real card size.
- [Card game](https://diypokecard.com/make-a-card-game): Simple home rules for playing with your own cards.
